sentences.text:
A.Sai Reddy Died By Lrs Appellant No. 2 ... vs The Special
Deputy Collector, on 12 March, 2025

Author: Abhinand Kumar Shavili
Bench: Abhinand Kumar Shavili
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Abhinand Kumar Shavili
 And
 Hon'Ble Smt Justice Tirumala Devi Eada
 L.A.A.S.No.403 Of 2009
Judgment:
(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice Abhinand Kumar Shavili) Aggrieved by the judgment and decree dated
05.04.2007 passed in O.P.No.134 of 1991 by the Senior Civil Judge, Wanaparthy, the present appeal
is filed b

. 
A perusal of the record shows that at the first instance, due to default committed by the 1st appellant, the Reference Court closed the OP on 21.02.1983 and thereafter, the OP was restored to its file.
Again due to the death of the 1st appellant and the LRs of the 1st appellant did not pursue the OP, the Reference Court again closed the OP on 16.03.1991.

Thereafter, on filing restoration application by the LRs of the 1st appellant, the OP was again restored to its file and finally, the OP was partly allowed vide order dated 05.04.2007, however, the Reference Court has denied interest on the enhanced compensation from the date of closure of the Reference at first on 21.02.1983 till the date of restoration of the Reference which is on 2.3.2007, but granted solatium at 30%.

The Reference Court has not granted additional market value of 12% since the Award was passed on 4.7.1979 by the Land Acquisition Officer which was much prior to the amendment made to the Act on 30.04.1982.

Due to the lapses on the part of the appellants in pursuing the OP diligently, the State should not suffer by paying huge interest and hence, the question of granting interest on the enhanced compensation does not arise.
Therefore, the Reference Court has rightly not granted interest on the enhanced compensation to the appellants.
Hence, this Court is not inclined to interfere with the order passed by the Reference Court.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
__ JUSTICEABHINAND KUMAR SHAVILI _____________________________ JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA Date: 12.03.2025
